groups.name: Original storage registration remains identical; existing reserved fields only
All 64 scene saves/recalls retain routes and all unrelated scene bytes
Cold restart restores last routes independently of startup scene; edits preserve snapshots
UI retains its selected source across a modeled DSP cache refresh
Legacy, unknown-version, out-of-range and invalid mono records fall back to Auto
Stock autosave observes route bytes and coalesces edits with unchanged 1500-tick delay

boundaries: Original scene copy/save/recall and autosave comparison/deadline ARM instructions execute
Storage requests are captured; flash erase/program and power-loss durability are not emulated
Storage nodes, time, singleton access, notifications and mutex calls are modeled
Restart fixtures supply the saved settings bytes; physical flash reload is untested
Text backup omits reserved fields; it does not export custom routes
